name: 4'-methyl-α-pyrrolidinopropiophenone
summary: 4'-Methyl-α-pyrrolidinopropiophenone (4-MePPP, MPPP or MαPPP) is a stimulant drug and substituted cathinone. It is structurally very similar to α-PPP, with only one added methyl group in the para position on the phenyl ring. 4-MePPP was sold in Germany as a designer drug in the late 1990s and early 2000s, along with a number of other pyrrolidinophenone derivatives.

uses.text: 4-MePPP was sold in Germany as a designer drug in the late 1990s and early 2000s, along with a number of other pyrrolidinophenone derivatives.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like α-PPP and other α-pyrrolidinophenones, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和α-PPP及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和α-PPP及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It shares the abbreviation MPPP with an unrelated opioid. In 1982, a botched home synthesis of that opioid produced a toxic by-product, MPTP, which caused permanent Parkinson's-like symptoms in several people in California.
fact.zh: 它與一種無關的鴉片類藥物共用MPPP這個縮寫。1982年，有人在家自製那種鴉片類藥物時失敗，產生了有毒副產物MPTP，導致加州數人出現永久性的類巴金森症狀。
fact.zhHans: 它与一种无关的鸦片类药物共用MPPP这个缩写。1982年，有人在家自制那种鸦片类药物时失败，产生了有毒副产物MPTP，导致加州数人出现永久性的类巴金森症状。
